name: Notes
description: Write notes, tag them and find them again by tag or text
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read notes; require auth for creating notes; restrict updating and deleting a note to the user who wrote it; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Notes belong to the signed-in user who created them; updating or deleting another user's note answers 403; DELETE /api/notes/:id removes the note permanently
Note validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; content, when given, is at most 20000 characters; pinned defaults to false
Tags: a note has at most 10 tags; each tag is trimmed and lower-cased, 1 to 30 characters, and duplicates are dropped; a missing tags list means no tags
Every note in a response carries author (the writer's username), created_at and updated_at; updated_at changes on every update

GET /api/notes returns active notes, pinned notes first and then most recently updated first; ?tag= keeps notes carrying that tag, ?author= keeps notes by that username, ?query= matches title or content case-insensitively, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching note
GET /api/tags lists every tag used by active notes with the number of notes carrying it, most used first
Deactivated notes (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/notes and GET /api/tags and answer 404 on the public note endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for another user's note or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the notes list and note details read-only; signed-in users also get a new-note button and, on their own notes, edit and delete controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to write notes' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Notes list: cards with title, the start of the content, tags, author and last update, pinned notes marked, a search box, previous/next paging and a 'My notes' switch for signed-in users
Tag filter chips built from /api/tags with their counts; choosing a chip filters the list by that tag and choosing it again clears the filter
Note editor for title, content, tags and pinned that shows the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first
Empty states for no notes at all and for a filter or search with no matches
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every note, active or not, with its author and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a note's active status from the overview

data_models.name: Note
data_models.description: A note written by a signed-in user

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who wrote it)
fields.title: string (required, max 200 chars)
fields.tags: list of strings (at most 10; each trimmed, lower-cased, 1-30 chars, no duplicates)
fields.updated_at: datetime (auto, changes on every update, ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the note from public endpoints)
